hero.title: {{appName}}: animal health records, payments and an AI assistant in one place
hero.subtitle: A platform for animal shelters, veterinarians and pet owners. Keep pet profiles and health logs, pay invoices online and ask the AI assistant by text or voice.

pets.title: Pet profiles
pets.text: Name, gender, birth date and owner for every animal in one list.

health.title: Health logs
health.text: A history of check-ups and medical procedures for each animal.

payments.title: Invoices and online payment
payments.text: Invoices for veterinary services, paid by bank card through Stripe.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.text: Ask about your animals, health logs and invoices by text or voice.

documents.title: Questions about documents
documents.text: Attach PDF documents to a chat and get answers based on their content.

account.title: Create an account
account.text: Sign up with email or with your Google account.

pets.title: Add your animals
pets.text: Create profiles and keep a health log for each animal.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.text: Open a chat, attach documents if needed and ask by text or voice.

who.question: Who is the platform for?
who.answer: For animal shelters, veterinary clinics and pet owners who want to keep animal records, health history and payments in one place.

assistant.question: What can the AI assistant do?
assistant.answer: It answers by text or voice using your data in the app: animals, health logs and invoices. For general veterinary questions it can search the web.

documents.question: Which documents can I attach?
documents.answer: PDF files up to {{maxSizeMb}} MB, up to {{maxDocuments}} documents per chat. Once a document is processed, you can ask the assistant about its content.

payments.question: How are invoices paid?
payments.answer: Online by bank card through Stripe. The invoice status updates automatically after the payment is confirmed.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: English, Russian and Ukrainian. You can switch the language at any time in the header.

signup.question: How do I sign up?
signup.answer: With an email and password or with your Google account.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Create an account and add your first animal in a couple of minutes.
